title: Missed Features From Previous Vehicles
summary: Reviews in this topic describe customers missing specific features from previous vehicles, including storage, summon capability, comfort-access door ridges, and a generally loved feature.

positive.summary: Positive reviews fondly recall previously loved features and express appreciation for comfort-access details they miss.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention missing storage and summon capability, but the excerpts do not provide enough context to classify the overall sentiment more specifically.

limitations: The topic combines several different missing features rather than a single clearly unified issue.
The sample is small, and some excerpts are too brief to determine sentiment beyond noting that a feature is missed.
The selected fragments are stratified samples and not representative estimates of the broader review population.
